title.narrative: USAID Laos Disability Sector Support (USAID Okard)

description.narrative: (Laos): The public perception in Laos of persons with disabilities remains negative and discriminatory, which sustains the biases and barriers that reduce the desire and the potential for persons with disabilities to participate fully in society. USAID Okard improves and sustains the independence and functional ability of persons with disabilities to facilitate their full participation and inclusion in society and enhance their overall well-being. Currently operating in the capital city of Vientiane and Xiengkhouang and Savannakhet provinces, the activity will implement the dioxin remediation directive and expand further into areas badly damaged affected during the Vietnam War era, including in areas heavily affected by unexploded ordnance and sprayed by agent orange. Victims are treated regardless of their age, sex, gender expression, ethnic origin, or indigenous status, and regardless of causes of disability. Okard will increase utilization of health services, provide economic opportunities, and strengthen the enabling environment for the improved quality of life of persons with disabilities through technical assistance to the Government of Laos (GOL) and organizations supporting persons with disabilities. In addition, the activity will provide support for small scale infrastructure adaptation related accessibility and income generation activities for people with disabilities.Through a community based inclusive development demonstration, interventions will also strengthen disability law and policy frameworks, improve accessibility of services, health and rehabilitation, social protection, livelihood opportunities, and promote the participation of people with disabilities in public life. These efforts contribute to the priorities of the GOL and advancing U.S. commitments in Laos by helping to address the legacies of conflict that are so vital to upholding U.S. leadership, values, and interests in Southeast Asia.

Objectives for Laos: USAID Okard aims to promote greater economic self-sufficiency, improve functional ability and well-being of persons with disabilities and their households, especially those who have mobility limitations and creating a conducive environment that allows persons with disabilities to participate optimally to the society. Objectives include: 1) Persons with disabilities and their households will have improved access to health and rehabilitation services. 2) More people with disabilities and their households will be employed or self-employed. 3) Health and economic empowerment improvements will be sustained through stakeholder engagement.
